text:
sara: quick follow-up from the RFC — proposing 'sequenced version tiers' as our migration model. idea is 1) stable legacy v1, 2) shimmable v2 compatibility layer, 3) opt-in new-surface v3. rollout by tenant cohorts and feature gates.

tom: curious — how do we decide shim vs runtime change? sidecar proxy or in-runtime adapter?

jess: runtime adapters are faster (no extra hop) but risky: KV cache layout and attention cache changes could break perf. sidecar gives isolation and an easy rollback.

sara: agreed. my leaning: start with sidecar/gateway for initial waves to reduce blast radius, then evaluate migrating hot paths into runtime after 2 quarters.

lee: telemetry question — what signals will we use to flip cohorts? request latency percentiles, 5xx rate, and model mismatch rate (via eval hooks). need a compact telemetry contract.

amanda: also product concern: how do we communicate opt-in? header? dashboard toggle? docs?

sara: both. header for programmatic opt-ins, dashboard toggle for customers wanting UI control, plus release notes + customer webinar for enterprises.

jess: header suggestion prototype:

```
X-Rwin-Version: 3
X-Rwin-Compat-OptIn: true
```

tom: +1. add X-Rwin-Canary:tenant-id for cohort attribution maybe.

lee: permissions & audit: toggles need to be RBAC-protected and emit audit events. infra-bot can synthesize events to S3.

infra-bot: deployment-check: `shim-sidecar` image size 120MB, healthcheck /ready returns 200 within 150ms locally. pushing canary tag to staging.

jess: rollback plan: circuit-breaker in gateway; if 99th latency spike > threshold OR 5xx > 0.5% for 5m, auto-fallback to v1. implement in service mesh or our routing layer.

tom: runbook item: preflight checklist -> migration tests (schema + streaming frames), perf baseline, golden prompts for quality regression.

sara: timeline proposal: week 0-2: sidecar PoC + tests; week 3-5: internal canary (non-prod tenants); week 6-8: limited customer opt-ins + telemetry tuning; week 9+: ramp to cohorts.

amanda: can we get a short customer-facing blurb draft? I can write it once we lock the header/toggle UX.

sara: will draft. final open questions: 1) exact telemetry contract schema (lee), 2) eviction/kv-cache compatibility matrix (jess), 3) UX wording for opt-in (amanda). assign owners?

lee: i’ll own telemetry contract.

jess: i’ll do the kv-cache compatibility matrix + perf checklist.

amanda: i’ll draft customer blurb and the dashboard flow.

sara: great — next sync in #arch next thursday. tagging owners: @lee @jess @amanda. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
